name: luna-advisor-work
description: Cost-efficient ChatGPT Work orchestration led by GPT-5.6 Luna, routing mechanical work to Luna, medium implementation to Terra, and complex reasoning to Sol.

interface.shortDescription: Luna-led economical orchestration with Terra implementation and Sol complexity escalation.
interface.longDescription: A Work-native cost-aware orchestrator. Prefer GPT-5.6 Luna in the parent session for routing, context management, synthesis, and routine verification. Route mechanical/light work to Luna, medium implementation to GPT-5.6 Terra, and complex architecture or ambiguous high-impact reasoning to GPT-5.6 Sol. Use fresh Sol review for critical outcomes. Parallelize independent read-heavy work and serialize shared-state writers.
defaultPrompt: Orchestrate this task with Luna Advisor Work using the cheapest lane that preserves correctness.
Use Luna for mechanical/routine work, Terra for medium implementation, Sol for complex reasoning, and fresh Sol review only for critical risk.
